answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
